interpretation: Provider convention, not independent radiometric calibration. Known catalog flag issues remain a source-quality limitation, especially false-flag scenes. No threshold was tuned and no direction truth was read.
role: Source-calibration correction before accepted results; rejected run-v2 retained
rule: Require explicit Earth Search BOA-offset-applied boolean and scale. If true use scale only; if false retain explicitly declared offset. Missing convention fails closed. Never apply an offset twice.
validity: Nonnegative finite contributing reflectances and finite nonzero normalized-index denominators; negative reflectance remains excluded/unknown, never clipped to make an index plausible.
